title: Yakitori-Style Chicken Skewers with Gooey Sauce
description: Grilled chicken skewers with a sweet and sticky gooey sauce, inspired by Japanese yakitori cuisine. Perfect for a quick dinner or snack.
instructions: Thread chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush both sides of the chicken with a little oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the chicken for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
In a small saucepan, combine gochujang, honey, soy sauce, hot sauce (if using), and brown sugar.
Bring the sauce to a simmer over medium heat and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until thickened slightly.
Brush the gooey sauce onto the grilled chicken during the last minute of cooking.
Remove the chicken from the grill and top with chopped rocket.
